'''Ronnie the Rocketpack Rodent''' was the mascot for the [[Galaxy Ways]] [[amusement park]] and resort on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]]. The character was noted for his courage. Shops in Galaxy Ways sold merchandise featuring the [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]], including full-body costumes.<ref name="GS">{{WEGCite|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen|story=Trouble at Galaxy Ways}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rodent symbol of the Galaxy Ways amusement park appears in the adventure seed "[[Trouble at Galaxy Ways]]" by [[Bill Olmesdahl]]. The scenario was published in the ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]] product for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the default version of the adventure, the player characters must face down hordes of hungry [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]] who attack the park's patrons to drag them away and eat them.<ref name="GS" />

However, Olmesdahl offers a variant wherein the Ranats are seeking not food but objects of veneration. In this version, the species has adopted Ronnie the Rocketpack Rodent as a [[Deity/Legends|deity]], and they are trying to steal as much merchandise featuring the character as they can.<ref name="GS" />
